[2026-05-24 04:32] CHORE-60 Task 30 — Team Task #64. Plan Task 30 at `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-05-23-library-page-ui-kit.md` L2876-2978.

### Why this is first (re-ordered from plan order)

Plan order was 28→29→30 but Tasks 28 + 29 reference `m.auth_login_*` / `m.auth_logout_*` keys that THIS task introduces. Per Bentham's per-commit-GREEN discipline, those tasks can't ship until your keys exist. So we re-ordered: 30 first, then 28, then 29.

### Pre-flight

```bash
pwd                                  # /home/michelek/workspace
git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD      # feat/library-page-ui-kit
git log --oneline -1                 # 14e772f feat(library): compose /library page from UI kit
git status --porcelain               # several scratchpad mods (M); they're not yours, leave them
```

### Your scope

1. **`messages/en.json`** — add the ~60 keys from plan L2888-2953 VERBATIM. Two key groups:
   - `library_*` (39 keys for the /library page wiring — not used yet by the committed +page.svelte, but added now for future wiring)
   - `auth_login_*`, `auth_provider_*`, `auth_logout_*` (used by Tasks 28+29 which land next)
   
   Watch: `auth_login_heading` may already exist with value `"Sign in"` — plan says replace with `"Welcome back"`. Verify current state of the key, then update if needed.

2. **`messages/et.json`, `lv.json`, `uk.json`** — mirror every new key. Plan explicitly allows `TODO et:` / `TODO lv:` / `TODO uk:` placeholders for uncertain translations. Use your judgment for what you can translate confidently from your session-14 work and prior conventions; mark the rest TODO.

3. **Regenerate paraglide bindings:**
   ```bash
   pnpm i18n:gen
   ```
   This regenerates `src/lib/paraglide/messages.js` with the new keys typed.

4. **Verify gate (atomic chain):**
   ```bash
   pnpm check && pnpm test:unit && pnpm lint && pnpm build
   ```
   Expected: all green. Since no code references the new keys yet (they're pure additions), there should be no churn beyond paraglide regeneration.

5. **Commit + push:**
   ```bash
   git add messages/en.json messages/et.json messages/lv.json messages/uk.json src/lib/paraglide/
   git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
i18n(library): add keys for /library + redesigned /auth/login + /auth/logout

Co-authored-by: Mihkel Putrinš <mihkel.putrinsh@gmail.com>
EOF
)"
   git push origin feat/library-page-ui-kit
   ```

   If `src/lib/paraglide/` is git-ignored (check `.gitignore`), drop it from `git add` — only the 4 message files commit.

   ASCII-only commit message (no em-dashes — L72 / CF Pages reject).

### Don't stage

- Scratchpad mods (bentham.md, tallis.md, your own comenius.md if you write to it) — owners commit at shutdown.

### Report + mark

SendMessage team-lead: commit SHA, # of new keys, count of TODO markers per locale (lets PO see translation backlog), gate results, new HEAD. `TaskUpdate(taskId=64, status=completed)`.

Update `teams/mvox-dev/memory/i18n-conventions.md` with any naming decisions you made (e.g., the library_* prefix family, parameterized message conventions) — your stewarded file.

Proceed.

[2026-05-24 05:08] **YELLOW-A fold-in — Team Task #69.** Bentham reviewed CHORE-60 branch at `[CHORE-60 BRANCH-REVIEW 2026-05-24]`: GREEN-eligible but YELLOW-A is "60 paraglide keys exist for /library but the page ships hardcoded English." PO call: fold in pre-merge.

### Scope

Wire `m.*()` substitutions into `src/routes/library/+page.svelte`. The keys all exist (you committed them at `f6247af`). NO new keys needed.

### Approximate substitutions (per Bentham's review)

~25 hardcoded English strings → `m.*()` calls. Examples Bentham named:
- "Library · librarian's desk" → `m.library_top_eyebrow()`
- "On the desk today" → `m.library_top_heading()`
- "Returns" / "Overdue" / "Pull for tonight" → `m.library_returns_title()` / `m.library_overdue_title()` / `m.library_pull_title()`
- "Catalog · 13 works" → `m.library_catalog_works({ n: '13' })` (parameterized — note `{n}` in the key)
- "Open full catalog ↗" → `m.library_catalog_open_full()`
- "Confirm ✓" → `m.library_returns_confirm({ n: <count> })`
- "Nudge both ✉" → `m.library_overdue_nudge_both()`
- "Folder · Bass section" → `m.library_returns_folder_label()`
- The Margin marginalia → `m.library_overdue_marginalia()` (this is the one with TODO markers in et/lv/uk — leave as-is; English passes through until PO supplies locale copy)
- Plus ~15 more across the page

Read `src/routes/library/+page.svelte` (currently at HEAD a3e4124), match every hardcoded English noun-phrase to a `library_*` key, sub. Add `import * as m from '$lib/paraglide/messages.js'` at top of the script block.

### Constraints

- **Surgical edits only** — don't touch structure, classes, component composition. Only replace strings.
- The page.spec.ts (4 tests) asserts on `container.textContent` for English literals like "Returns", "Catalog · 13 works", "Thomas Tallis" (fixture data). Paraglide outputs the same UTF-8 strings, so tests stay GREEN. If a parameterized substitution changes the rendered text (e.g., spacing), update the relevant assertion in page.spec.ts to match — that's the refactor-rule case.

### Atomic chain

```bash
pnpm i18n:gen && \
  pnpm check && pnpm test:unit && pnpm lint && pnpm build && \
  git add src/routes/library/+page.svelte && \
  git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
i18n(library): wire paraglide m.*() into /library page

Per Bentham YELLOW-A [CHORE-60 BRANCH-REVIEW 2026-05-24].

Co-authored-by: Mihkel Putrinš <mihkel.putrinsh@gmail.com>
EOF
)" && \
  git push origin feat/library-page-ui-kit
```

If page.spec.ts assertion breaks because of parameterized formatting, stage both files in the same commit (`git add src/routes/library/+page.svelte src/routes/library/page.spec.ts`) — that's a refactor-rule mechanical fix in your scope.

Pre-flight: branch feat/library-page-ui-kit @ a3e4124.

### Report + mark

SendMessage team-lead with commit SHA + gate results + count of substitutions made + which key prefixes (library_*, etc) + new HEAD. `TaskUpdate(taskId=69, status=completed)`.

After this lands, I'll file YELLOW-B + YELLOW-C as follow-up GH issues, then hand to Josquin for Phase 6 merge.

Proceed.

[2026-05-24 05:40] YELLOW-D fold-in — Team Task #70. PO call after your color-regression flag: restructure the 4 catalog-stats keys so the per-number color survives. ### Scope **4 NEW keys** in `messages/en.json`: ``` "library_catalog_owned_unit": "copies owned", "library_catalog_available_unit": "available", "library_catalog_on_loan_unit": "on loan", "library_catalog_overdue_unit": "overdue" ``` Mirror to et/lv/uk (best-effort translations or `TODO et:` markers — same pattern as Task #64). **Existing parameterized keys** (`library_catalog_owned`, `_available`, `_on_loan`, `_overdue`) — LEAVE in place. They become unused but removing them is out of scope. ### Rewire /library/+page.svelte catalog stats area The catalog strip needs to go from: ```svelte {m.library_catalog_owned({ n: String(stats.copies) })} · ... ``` …back to per-number-colored spans, like the original pre-wiring shape: ```svelte {stats.copies} {m.library_catalog_owned_unit()} · {stats.available} {m.library_catalog_available_unit()} · {stats.on_loan} {m.library_catalog_on_loan_unit()} · {stats.overdue} {m.library_catalog_overdue_unit()} ``` ### Atomic chain ```bash pnpm i18n:gen && \ pnpm check && pnpm test:unit && pnpm lint && pnpm build && \ git add messages/en.json messages/et.json messages/lv.json messages/uk.json src/routes/library/+page.svelte && \ git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF' i18n(library): split catalog-stats keys to restore per-number coloring Per PO call on YELLOW-D follow-up to [CHORE-60 BRANCH-REVIEW 2026-05-24]. Parameterized library_catalog_{owned,available,on_loan,overdue} keys remain in messages files but are now unused; per-number color spans + unit-label keys restore the original design. Co-authored-by: Mihkel Putrinš EOF )" && \ git push origin feat/library-page-ui-kit ``` Pre-flight: branch feat/library-page-ui-kit @ 615a7e0. If page.spec.ts asserts on `"Catalog · 13 works"` substring or similar, those should still pass because the rendered text concatenates identically. ### Report + mark SendMessage with commit SHA + gate results + new HEAD + TODO marker count delta. `TaskUpdate(taskId=70, status=completed)`. After this lands, branch is ready for Josquin Phase 6 merge. YELLOW-B (MvoxNav) + YELLOW-C (textSnippet warning) will file as follow-up GH issues. Proceed.
